memories.empty.title: No memories yet
memories.empty.hint: Tell the AI to remember something, or add one here. Memories are shown to the AI at the start of every turn.
editor.contentHint: {{count}}/{{max}} · one short sentence; #tags and [[links]] make it easier to find
editor.errorSecret: This looks like a password or key. Memories should not contain secrets.
daily.addPlaceholder: Add a note to today's log
daily.empty.title: Nothing logged this day
daily.empty.hint: The AI adds what was done and decided, and a short summary when a session ends.
scratch.placeholder: Add something to come back to
scratch.empty.title: Nothing on the scratchpad
scratch.empty.hint: Unfinished work and follow-ups. Open items are shown to the AI at the start of every turn.
recovery.empty.title: No recently deleted memories
recovery.empty.hint: Anything you or the AI forget is kept here, so it can be restored.
settings.autoExtract.hint: After each reply, a model picks out lasting preferences and facts to remember. Uses your model quota.
settings.sessionSummary.hint: When a session ends, add a short summary to the daily log. Uses your model quota.
settings.model.hint: A cheaper, faster model is usually enough.
settings.snapshotMode.stable.hint: The memory block stays identical between checkpoints, which keeps prompt caching effective. It refreshes when memories change, when the context is compacted and on a new day.
settings.snapshotMode.per-turn.hint: Rebuilt every turn and adds the best matches for your message, but breaks prompt caching on local models.
settings.injectLimit.hint: Pinned first, then the newest. The AI can search for the rest.
settings.injectCharBudget.hint: Caps how much memory text is added to each turn.
settings.clearAll.hint: The daily log and scratchpad are kept. You can still restore them from Recently deleted.
settings.clearAll.confirm: Delete every long-term memory? You can restore them from Recently deleted.
